steps.text: Login to application & Land on cards dashboard page
Select debit card from drop down list & Click on ‘Card Settings’ consisting of Manage Card PIN and Manage Card Limits

Click on ‘Manage Card PIN’ 
Includes: 
1- Unblock Card PIN (old feature) 
2- Reset Card PIN (new feature)
Customer enters a new 4 digit PIN
Customer confirms the new PIN by re-entering it
Then enter the OTP correctly for verification and submit it
